up: Retrieve all distinct molecules that are linked to the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1123859. The document is identified via the `docs` table. Molecules are linked to documents through the `compound_records` table (which has `doc_id`). For each molecule, provide its ChEMBL identifier (from `molecule_dictionary.chembl_id`), its compound name (from `molecule_dictionary.pref_name`), and its canonical SMILES (from `compound_structures.canonical_smiles`). Only include molecules that have a non-null canonical SMILES. Return one row per molecule. Order the results by `chembl_id`, then `compound_name`, then `canonical_smiles` (all ascending).
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name AS compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1123859' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles;
